# PDF.js for parent-letter PNG export

Pinned `pdfjs-dist` **4.10.38**, legacy build, Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).
The archive URL, SHA-256, and shipped file list are recorded in VERSION.json.
The upstream legacy build targets Chrome 103 and later. Actual browser versions tested
for this project change are recorded separately in the audit documentation.

Official source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/tree/v4.10.38

Only PDFs generated by the authenticated parent-letter endpoint are loaded.
The library renders PDF pages to temporary browser canvases with `isEvalSupported: false`.
Worker and standard fonts are served locally. PDF generation and the existing viewer stay unchanged.
